server_url.title: Pastegate Server URL
server_url.description: URL of the self-hosted Pastegate backend (e.g. https://pastegate.company.com)

api_key.title: Pastegate API Key
api_key.description: API key for authenticating with the Pastegate backend

lang.title: Default language
lang.description: Organisation UI language (used if the server does not send default_lang): 'de', 'en', 'fr' or 'es'

user_identity.title: User identity
user_identity.description: Optional identity of the device user (e.g. UPN/e-mail). Overrides the browser profile e-mail. Stored encrypted on the server and only visible to itsec/infosec users (every lookup is audit-logged).
